marks.rule: a lit bar on the glass's bottom edge over each note knob, as drawn

pattern.note.rule: START counts bars, beats of the meter's denominator and sixteenths from 1 (a fourth field in 64ths when the start is off the sixteenth); LENGTH is the reduced fraction of a whole note

bars.rule: the lattice's column span divided equally; a line between bars

notes.rule: columns by time over the phrase; one row per semitone, compressed when the range exceeds the rows; each note two rows tall; the pitch range centred

lit.rule: each note fills its exact time span over its two rows, inset on every side, so notes of one length are one width and notes in a row stay apart, with a seam between its rows, in the colour over the glass; overlapping notes merge

host_contract.buttons: face, legend and unlit LED are in the plate; hover, pressed, keyboard focus and disabled are drawn by the host; the AI toggle's lit LED comes from the skin; momentary buttons keep their LEDs dark
host_contract.levers: the plate has bare panel; the host draws the up or down sprite at the pivot; a click toggles, a drag of 8 px or more picks the direction, Up/Down pick a position and Space/Enter toggle; one command per change
host_contract.displays: the plate holds smoothed glass; the host draws the unlit dot lattice from the profile, then each line in the bundled font at its fitted cap and scale, lit on the lattice at the ripple chosen by eye
host_contract.overview: the host draws the lit cells of the pattern by the measured block model, then the bar lines and numbers for the pattern's length
host_contract.keyboard: Tab follows focus_order within the session bar, then the strip, + ADD RACK and the open side unit, whose screen is one stop; Space/Enter press; Escape closes an entry without committing it
host_contract.accessibility: buttons are buttons, the AI toggle and levers are toggle buttons with their position as value, displays are static text whose value is today's full text, the overview is an image with a summary
host_contract.side_units: the AI unit and the LIBRARY share the slot right of the rack: the session's AI button shows the AI unit, the rack's + ADD RACK shows the LIBRARY (and darkens the AI LED); APPLY or CANCEL closes the LIBRARY
host_contract.mode_leds: GENERATE blinks while a Generate request runs, REFINE while a Refine request runs; AUDITION is lit while the proposal plays; APPLY blinks while an Apply waits, else is lit while a proposal with audio is ready; the LIBRARY's APPLY is lit while the LIBRARY previews a rack at a place. A blink is 250 ms on, 250 ms off, from one clock; STOP, DISCARD and CANCEL stay dark. Each lights ai:mode.lit scaled by its lens radius over the sprite's
host_contract.screens: the plate holds clean glass; the host draws the page: lettering in the bundled fonts at the measured styles, rules, bars, outlines, checkboxes, arrows and the caret; clicks on a page's rows act as their binds say; the prompt and entries are text editors over their slots
host_contract.pattern_unit: PATTERN on the strip unfolds this unit over the rack area and the strip, its bottom on the stage's; PATTERN here folds it; it and the side units exclude each other, the one opened last staying
host_contract.programmer: ADVANCED on the session's lever shows the PROGRAMMER in the rack area; it and the side units exclude each other, the one opened last staying; the unfolded pattern unit covers its lower part
host_contract.knobs: the plate holds the pattern unit's knob bodies, the PROGRAMMER's are drawn from one sprite; the pointer turns over the sweep with the value's fraction of its range
